_comment: THE KNOB REGISTRY. One definition per setting, and the only place a default lives.
docs/routine_config.schema.json  the Routine Configuration Schema the platform reads
Edit this file and re-run the generator; never edit the generated files.
name     the knob, and the environment variable unless 'env' says otherwise
default  what the entrypoint uses when nothing arrives from the platform
blank    what an empty string from the platform means (schemas often send '')
scope    operational | model   -- model knobs change results, operational ones do not
tasks    which TASK values the knob applies to; [] means all

knobs.name: TASK
knobs.label: Workflow / Task
knobs.desc: Which workflow task to run: 'smoke' executes a minimal verification test proving the container, mounts, and interfaces; 'downscale' runs the Cascading Gamble spatial allocation; 'swat' runs the SWAT+ water model post-processor; 'biodiversity' runs the Biodiversity Link post-processor; 'postprocess' runs SWAT+ and Biodiversity Link on existing downscaling results; 'all' runs the complete pipeline (downscaling + SWAT+ + Biodiversity Link).

knobs.name: MACRO_MODEL
knobs.label: Macro Economic Model
knobs.desc: Which macro-economic model to downscale and process: 'globiom', 'capri', 'image', 'magnet', 'clumondo', or 'all' to process all models in sequence.

knobs.name: SCENARIO
knobs.label: Macro / Policy Scenario
knobs.desc: Scenario to evaluate: 'base' runs the baseline reference path; 'all' runs every available scenario for the selected model.

knobs.name: RUN_SWAT
knobs.label: Run Water Quality Model (SWAT+)
knobs.desc: Whether to run SWAT+ water quality simulations (nutrient runoff, nitrogen and phosphorus leaching, streamflow, catchment sediment yield). Set to 1 for on, 0 for off.

knobs.name: RUN_BIODIVERSITY
knobs.label: Run Biodiversity Model (Biodiversity Link)
knobs.desc: Whether to run the Biodiversity Link ecological effects model (species richness, Mean Species Abundance MSA, habitat fragmentation, ecosystem intactness). Set to 1 for on, 0 for off.

knobs.name: YEARS
knobs.label: Time Horizon / Years
knobs.desc: Simulation years to process. 'all' downscales and simulates all standard time steps (2000, 2010, 2020, 2030, 2040, 2050); or pass comma-separated years.

knobs.name: RESOLUTION
knobs.label: Grid Spatial Resolution
knobs.desc: Target grid resolution for downscaling and subsequent impact assessment. Standard Act4Cap grid is 10km (EEA EPSG:3035).

knobs.name: NCORES
knobs.label: Parallel CPU Cores
knobs.desc: Number of CPU cores allocated for parallel raster processing, IPF gravity allocation, and catchment-level environmental calculations.

knobs.name: SMOKE
knobs.label: Smoke Test Mode
knobs.desc: Set to 1 to run a fast smoke test over a regional 1-pixel slice, verifying container environment, mounts, and interfaces without full computation. Set to 0 for production.

knobs.name: FORCE
knobs.label: Force Re-run Existing Outputs
knobs.desc: Set to 1 to force re-computation and overwrite existing outputs on the drive. Left at 0 to resume from completed stages.

knobs.name: WORK_DIR
knobs.label: Persistent Storage Mount (FUSE)
knobs.desc: The cluster FUSE mount path where persistent inputs and outputs are symlinked so the platform retains and collects them at job completion.

knobs.name: OUTPUT_DIR
knobs.label: Output Subdirectory
knobs.desc: Directory where downscaled land use, GeoTIFF indicators, SWAT+ outputs, and Biodiversity Link metrics are written.

knobs.name: INPUT_DIR
knobs.label: Input Subdirectory
knobs.desc: Directory containing macro model tabular data, baseline spatial maps, prior weights, and catchment boundary shapefiles.

knobs.name: CASCADING_GAMBLE_DIR
knobs.label: Cascading Gamble Core Path
knobs.desc: Filesystem path to the cascadinggamble-core downscaling engine codebase or vendored module.
